details:
This update for python-Django fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-77050: potential denial-of-service in `get_supported_language_variant()` when processing many distinct, very
  long language codes (bsc#1284481).
- CVE-2026-84429: potential denial-of-service attack due to quadratic time complexity when parsing a value with many
  separators inside a quoted parameter (bsc#1284476).
- CVE-2026-87890: An incomplete fix for CVE-2026-15307 in Django spatial lookups allows an attacker who can supply
  `bytes` values to cause the Django process to make network requests via a crafted VRT document (bsc#1284472).
- CVE-2026-87975: an authenticated user permitted to submit a formset to delete rows outside the limiting queryset,
  without any permission on the targeted object, marking an out-of-queryset object for deletion (bsc#1284471).
